messages:
maya: quick heads-up — forecasting model just bumped EU production demand, looks like ~120 H100s shortfall hitting mid-May. vendor call w/ Tony at 11:00 had two constraints: vendor lead time 6–8w and RMA pool limited to 20 units per week. we need a tactical plan :chart_with_upwards_trend:
lia: can you paste the PO numbers / vendor quote? need to see pricing delta for air vs sea. also who owns customs HS classification for expedited shipments?
tony_vendor: hey all — confirmed: our factory can stagger shipments weekly. standard sea is 6–8w, airlift window ~2w but +$16k–22k per 20 units depending on carrier. RMA outbound (refurbs) can be bundled but customs docs must include HS: 8471.80, and we need buyer-signed commercial invoice for any air expedite.
oliver: immediate infra question — if we get staggered arrivals, can we stage installs into eu-dedicated pool without re-tagging? we have ~40 spare slots in dedicated-eu but those are pinned to another commit. risk: over-provisioning will hit committed capacity and cost.
ben: operationally we can do phased node bring-ups. plan: receive -> QA -> label node as "staging/eu/hold" -> run burn-in for 48h, then promote. kubectl snippet for drain/uncordon works fine: 
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# after install: kubectl uncordon gpu-node-<id>
```
maya: thanks. Lia, what's the expedite cost break-even? if air +$18k per 20 but avoids 6w lost revenue, we should compute delta. include ops cost for staging (burn-in time x engineer hours).
lia: rough numbers — lost product throughput est $45k/week if we miss May launch. expedite for first 60 units (3 shipments) ~ $54k–66k. sea option lowest ~$0 but 6–8w delay. i'll run a quick ROI and post updated quote by EOD.
ben: small heads-up — we saw recent thermal warnings on older h100s in eu-staging. if we mix refurbished RMA units with new straight-from-factory, QA gate needs separate thermal profile check to avoid cohort regression. SRE-bot will flag if thermal events spike during burn-in.
sre-bot: ALERT (informational): last 30d eu-staging thermal events: 2.1% above baseline. recommended extra 24h thermal soak on RMAs.
tony_vendor: can do separate manifests: new units + RMA refurb batch. recommend shipping new units first (priority air if we go that way) and RMA refurbs via sea consolidated to avoid high cost. also can split commercial invoice to show refurbished discount for customs.
maya: alternative hybrid: air 20 new units (fastest) + sea consolidated RMAs for replenishment. that would give ~20 units in 2w and then ramp. can we get 3 air windows?
tony_vendor: yes, but third air jump incurs carrier peak surcharge (~10%) if booked in same billing week. still cheaper than missing product launch.
oliver: from infra side, can we triage capacity to critical services first? recommend reserve 30 GPUs for latency-critical routes and schedule batch jobs to warm pool overnight. i'll create a deploy gating doc and share link.
lia: filing amendment to PO to allow split shipments and add HS code + expedited invoice clause. need Maya / Oliver sign-off for staging SLA changes.
maya: OK — sign off on staging SLA change. Oliver, please post the gating doc link when ready. Lia, once you have ROI numbers, ping finance for expedite approval. Tony, request week-by-week ETA per shipment and provisional AWB when available.
ben: i'll prep the burn-in checklist and thermal soak steps. Expect ops crew to need ~4 engineers for rolling installs across two weeks if we go staggered.
maya: action items summary: 1) Lia run ROI + update PO (EOD). 2) Tony provide per-shipment ETA + provisional AWB (within 24h). 3) Oliver share deploy gating doc (2h). 4) Ben publish burn-in checklist (today). we'll reconvene after Lia posts numbers. thanks :airplane: :ship:
